senses.gloss: pr. n. (b. h.) Michael, name of an angel.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 25:2">Targ. Job XXV, 2</cite> (sec. vers.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 137:7">Targ. Ps. CXXXVII, 7</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Chagigah 12b:6">Ḥag. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ השר הגדול</he> M., the great chief; <cite ref="Menachot 110a">Men. 110ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:13">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵃ</cite> bot. one in distress <he>לא יצווח לא למ׳ וכ׳</he> cries not to M. nor to Gabriel, but &c.—
Num. R. s. 2; Pesik. R. s. 46 מי כמוך ואין כאל הרי מ׳ Michael is a combination of mi (Ex. XV, 11) and kaël (Deut. XXXIII, 26); a. fr.
